limitations: Routing is exercised while receiver event loops are available. Blocked-runtime integration, nested spawn, detached cleanup, cancellation and complete shutdown still require work.
The diagnostic installs one matching native callback table slot per instance to observe delivery through real Wasm queues; it is not general dynamic linking.
Full application main, the original const_fold benchmark, IO host integration, packaging and other native platforms remain open.
This uses upstream message fallback semantics; native Atomics.waitAsync support remains a separate gap.
